title: Blind XML external-entity test
summary: Test only an observed XML parser with a fresh, harmless OAST canary.
steps: Confirm the mapped POST/PUT/PATCH endpoint accepts XML; capture a normal request and an inert XML control.
Register a fresh Interactsh session and use its callback URL in a single external-entity reference. Do not read local files or target metadata services.
Submit the XML canary to the observed parser with run_oob_callback_workflow (raw body placeholder) or a recorded replay; preserve the request evidence ID.
Poll the same session after the plant. A DNS or HTTP event must match the fresh payload domain and occur after the request.
Use oob_callback proof with register_id, plant_id, and poll_id. A parser error, reflected entity text, or unrelated callback is inconclusive.
Describe only demonstrated external-entity resolution; do not claim file read or internal-network access without separate proof.
pass_signals: Fresh XML entity causes a correlated DNS or HTTP callback
